'''Vuhlg Worrik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as the head of the [[Morjanssik Mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After [[Moren Chonk]], the [[Chief Manager]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Morjanssik]], was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by a group of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] saboteurs, a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents were blamed for the crime and were arrested in the Morjanssik Mine. Worrik was uncertain as to whether the Rebels were guilty of the crime, so he visited them and stated that he would not hand them over to the Morjanssik authorities if they could provide him with indisputable proof that they were innocent.
